title: SecureNLP - Malware Report Semantic Extraction
description: Semantic extraction from cybersecurity (APT malware) reports, following SemEval-2018 Task 8 (SecureNLP) on the MalwareTextDB corpus: classify whether a sentence is relevant to malware actions/capabilities, then tag tokens with the Action / Entity / Modifier labels and assign MAEC attribute categories to Action tokens.
